action.objective: Capture the c3 bishop with bxc3, restoring material and keeping the initiative, then develop and centralize.
action.rationale: b2c3 is the only commit_ready move: exact depth-4 score 35, no mate-in-one, no tactical refutation, line bxc3 g8 Nb5 Nc6 keeps pieces active. Broad depth-3 (59) is not comparable. Other top candidates are bounded upper estimates, not safer.
